opening.argument: The video presents e-commerce live chat as a tool for customer support and online sales workflows. It describes proactive help for customers and co-browsing to assist with checkout; the sampled imagery shows a chat dashboard and a customer conversation on a shopping page. In that context, the call to try ProProfs Chat for free is an ordinary software offer, not a request for investment, payment, credentials, or other financial participation. The sampled text and frames establish the software topic and branding, but they do not establish that every product claim is true or that any external service delivers a particular outcome.

citations.quote: How to Improve Customer Support with Ecommerce Live Chat Tool
With LiveChat, you can offer instant proactive help to customers.
With a good live chat. Software you can also co-browse with your customers and help them check out. Seamlessly.
